This capability must allow operators to identify and prioritize interoperability issues and potential workarounds within a single system. • 3.1.3.2 Platform Issue Tracking: The software shall provide a mechanism to record and maintain a history of platform-specific issues (e.g., design, testing, operational) through their entire lifecycle. deliverables_scope.text: ===== FILE: files/SOW_for_F4F1AS6251AC01.pdf ===== PERFORMANCE WORK STATEMENT Trailer-Mounted Vacuum Excavator 1. Scope The contractor shall furnish and deliver one (1) new trailer-mounted vacuum excavator system for use by the 88th Communications Squadron cable maintenance section. 2. Purpose The equipment is required to support the safe location and excavation of delicate buried fiber optic cables and the removal of water and organic sludge from manhole systems. 3. BUILDINGS 1020,1030 & 1040 AT Edwards AFB, California Prepared by: Phillip Folson Jr. Chief, Maintenance and Logistics Operations Division AFMC 445 TS/EWJX Christina Calkins, Acquisition Project Specialist 445 TS/EWJP 21 April 2026 8 May 2026 8 June 2026 12 August 2026 Contents GENERAL 3 HOURS OF OPERATION, SAFETY 15 SECURITY REQUIREMENTS 18 APPENDIX DEFINITIONS 24 ACRONYMS 26 GENERAL 1.0 PURPOSE This Performance Work Statement (PWS) outlines the nonpersonal service contract to provide Test Support Equipment Control and Monitoring Systems (TSECMS) contractor requirements for the 412th Test Wing Electronic Warfare Group (EWG)/Electronic Warfare Joint Logistics (EWJX) Division at the Avionics Test and Integration Complex (ATIC) at Edwards AFB, CA, The respective site leadership shall oversee upgrades, repairs, modifications, all related operations, and maintenance performed on the TSECMS assets and capabilities used at these locations under the support services agreement. These assets are used to maintain and optimize existing TSECMS that primarily supports test operations in buildings 1020, 1030, and 1040 at Edwards AFB, CA, this effort shall be performed on the existing Government-owned chamber and fa

ystem (BAS) platform. The system utilizes logic programming consistent with the installed OEM platform to support a wide range of Systems Under Test (SUTs). The Liquid Cooling Unit System is monitored to provide avionics cooling fluid at varying system pressures and flows to support liquid cooled onboard aircraft systems. Also, a custom built 400Hz Electrical System is controlled and monitored to provide 400Hz power to various aircraft and other SUT. In general, a TSECMS is primarily used to control critical equipment and systems to operate, control and monitor aircraft support equipment parameters and connected secondary systems. 3.0 SCOPE OF WORK The work covered by this PWS consists of a contractor furnishing all supervision, labor, equipment and materials necessary to maintain the existing hardware and software for the Test Support Equipment Control and Monitoring Systems (TSECMS). The Contractor shall maintain, manage, troubleshoot, repair, replace, install, configure, connect and commission SCS of both the hardware and software.
